extName.description: Extension name shown in chrome://extensions and Chrome Web Store. DO NOT TRANSLATE — proper noun, must remain identical in all locales.

extDescription.message: ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / GoogleAI / Grok / X内Grok のチャット履歴を横断管理する Chrome 拡張
extDescription.description: Extension short description in manifest.json (max 132 bytes UTF-8). Service brand names (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, GoogleAI, Grok) are proper nouns — DO NOT TRANSLATE.

actionTitle.description: Tooltip shown on hover over the toolbar action icon. DO NOT TRANSLATE — proper noun.

actionSync.description: Header button label that triggers the sync flow.

actionCancel.description: Generic cancel button label used in dialogs.

actionCopyUrl.description: Tooltip and aria-label for the row-level URL copy button.

actionFavorite.description: Tooltip and aria-label for the row-level favorite (♥) toggle.

a11yMenu.description: Aria-label and tooltip for the ⋯ menu summary button.

a11yDateRangeFilter.description: Aria-label for the date range group inside the filter section.

chipWithCount.description: Service chip label with a count badge. ja uses no space (`All(15)`); en uses a space before the parenthesis (`All (15)`).

filterDatePresetAll.description: Date range preset chip for showing all dates.

filterSearchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder and aria-label for the title search input.

filterSortDesc.description: Sort direction button label (descending = newest first).

accountAllWithCount.description: Account select option label with a count badge.

menuExportJson.description: Menu item that exports all records as a JSON file.

emptyNoHistoryHint.description: Empty-state hint suggesting the user runs sync.

emptyFilteredHint.description: Empty-state hint suggesting the user adjust filters.

dialogMismatchTitle.message: 別アカウントのチャットです
dialogMismatchTitle.description: Title of the account-mismatch warning dialog.

dialogMismatchTargetLabel.description: Prefix label before the target account email in the mismatch dialog body. Includes trailing space.

dialogMismatchCopyUrl.description: Button label that copies the conversation URL to clipboard.

dialogMismatchOpenAnyway.description: Button label that opens the conversation in current browser despite mismatch.

dialogSyncTitle.description: Title of the sync-services selection dialog.

dialogSyncConfirm.description: Confirm button label inside the sync dialog.

dialogDeleteTitle.message: 削除対象を選択(取消不可)
dialogDeleteTitle.description: Title of the delete-services selection dialog. The (irreversible) suffix is intentional.

dialogDeleteConfirm.description: Confirm button label inside the delete dialog.

dialogSelectionAll.description: Checkbox label for the All option in sync/delete dialogs.

serviceXgrok.description: Display name for the Grok feature embedded in X.com. Use proper noun for the rest (ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/GoogleAI/Grok).

commonUntitled.description: Fallback label for records without a title (rec.title is empty).

badgeMismatch.description: Row badge shown when the record's accountEmail differs from the current Chrome profile.

statusLoginRequired.description: Status label for the not_logged_in error code.

statusNetworkError.description: Status label for the network_error code (fetch TypeError).

statusTabUnreachable.description: Status label for the tab_unreachable code (no matching tab found).

statusContentUnreachable.description: Status label for the content_unreachable code (content script not injected; reload tab).

statusAccountUnknown.description: Status label for account_email_not_found / screenname_not_found codes.

statusDomChanged.description: Status label for pfp_not_found / userid_not_found / history_container_not_found / profile_link_not_found codes.

statusInvalidOrg.description: Status label for the invalid_org_entry code (Claude organization parsing failed).

statusInvalidShape.description: Status label for the unexpected_response_shape code.

statusSessionFailed.description: Status label for the session_retrieval_failed code (Gemini).

statusConvFetchFailed.description: Status label for the conversations_retrieval_failed code (X-Grok).

statusGenericError.description: Status label for unrecognized error codes.

statusErrorUnknown.description: Fallback used when an error string is missing.

syncing.description: Sync button text during a sync flow (with spinner).

syncBtnTotalCount.description: Sync button text after a multi-service sync completes.

syncBtnSingleCount.description: Sync button text after a single-service sync completes.

syncBtnFailed.description: Sync button text when all services fail.

statusSyncRowOk.description: Per-service sync success row in the status bar.

statusSyncFailed.message: 同期失敗: 詳細はコンソール

syncActionGrok.message: タブで開いてから再同期してください
